title: WOS Studio (Authoring) — Readiness (ValidationFinding + Rule Registry)
description: Studio readiness shapes per studio/specs/readiness-validation.md. Top-level kind discriminator selects ValidationFinding (single finding) or RuleRegistry (catalog of rules) or ValidationReport (collection of findings for a workspace/workflow). ValidationFinding carries tier (S1-S6), ruleId, severity ∈ {info|warn|error|block}, subjectRef, message, suggestedFix, lifecycleState (open|acknowledged|resolved). Waiver state is no longer a discriminator on lifecycleState: per ADR-0093, a finding is waived iff it carries a `waiver` field of shape `WaiverAttestationRef` (a Studio-profile projection of `rkaf:Attestation` targeting the Finding IRI). ValidationFinding aligns with `rkaf:Finding` (ADR-0093 Phase A) on `findingKind`/`detectedAt`/`detectedBy`/`subject`/`severity`; Studio-profile extras (`ruleId`, `tier`, lifecycle) compose at the Studio layer.
$comment: Promotion status (Stage-3, 2026-05-01): MVP shape; rule registry is Stage-4 territory but schema accepts the shape so the registry can be authored as data.

x-lm.intent: Document type marker for Studio readiness artifacts

$wosStudioReadiness.description: Document marker pinning this artifact to the Studio Readiness 1.0 schema family.

waived.description: Count of findings in this tier carrying a `waiver` Attestation (ADR-0093: waiver state is expressed by the presence of `waiver: WaiverAttestationRef`, not by `lifecycleState=waived`). This is NOT a `lifecycleState` counter — `lifecycleState` enumerates `{open, acknowledged, resolved}` only.

ValidationFinding.description: Studio-profile projection of `rkaf:Finding` (ADR-0093 Phase A). The rkaf:Finding-aligned core (`findingKind`, `detectedAt`, `detectedBy`, `subject`, `severity`) is the typed handle a Studio finding inherits from Rulespec; Studio-profile extras (`ruleId`, `tier`, `lifecycleState`, `suggestedFix`, `waiver`) compose at the Studio layer per the §5.2 editorial rule of the framework spec. `severity` keeps the Studio four-rung ladder (`info|warn|error|block`) — Studio severity SHOULD be mapped to/from `rkaf:FindingSeverity` (`informational|operationalConflict|publicationBlocking|authorityCritical`) at the Studio↔Rulespec boundary (mapping table in studio/specs/readiness-validation.md §WOS mappings). Waiver state is expressed by the presence of `waiver: WaiverAttestationRef` (a Studio projection of `rkaf:Attestation(targetFinding=this)`), not by a `lifecycleState=waived` discriminator.

id.description: Studio-local finding id. IRI-addressable per ADR-0093 once the finding lifts to a `rkaf:Finding` IRI for cross-stack waiver Attestations.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier from the readiness rule registry. Studio rules use SA-MUST/SA-SHOULD prefixes; cross-cutting rules use family prefixes (EFF/AI/CMP/EQ/ACC/JUR/ID/COMP/CHAIN/TERM); WOS-side rules use their parent ids (K-/G-/AI-/SIG-).

tier.description: Readiness tier this finding belongs to (per readiness-validation.md).

severity.description: Severity. `block` cannot be advanced past without an explicit waiver Attestation (see `waiver`). Maps to `rkaf:FindingSeverity` at the Studio↔Rulespec boundary.

x-lm.intent: Severity drives whether the finding blocks advancement — load-bearing for tier gates

findingKind.description: rkaf:Finding alignment (ADR-0093). Closed taxonomy of detection categories. Open extension via partner URIs is intentionally NOT permitted at L1; extensions go through a Rulespec RFC. Producers MUST emit a value; when no narrower kind applies, emit `rkaf:other` explicitly. (The schema previously carried `default: "rkaf:other"`; that was informational only and produced silently-empty `findingKind` in non-strict consumers. Dropped F3 (2026-05-13) once `findingKind` became required per F1.)

detectedAt.description: rkaf:Finding alignment (ADR-0093). When the detection happened. Replaces the legacy `openedAt` (kept as alias via additionalProperties: true for the migration window).

detectedBy.description: rkaf:Finding alignment (ADR-0093). IRI of the detector (lint rule id, BVR id, validator).

subject.description: rkaf:Finding alignment (ADR-0093). IRI of the object the finding concerns. The Studio-profile mirrors this onto `subjectRef` for backward-compat consumers; new producers SHOULD emit both fields during the migration window.

lifecycleState.description: Finding lifecycle, sans `waived`. A finding is waived iff it carries a `waiver` field (per ADR-0093: waiver state collapses to `Attestation(targetFinding=…)`). A waived finding's `lifecycleState` SHOULD remain `open` or `acknowledged`; the Attestation is the override record, not a state mutation.

waiver.description: Optional. When present, this finding is waived by the referenced Attestation. Per ADR-0093 §Decision item 2: the four pre-cutover waiver-flavor data clumps (`parsingWaiverRef`, `sensitivityWaiverRef`, scenario `waiver`, ValidationFinding flat `waivedBy`/`waivedRationale`/`waivedAt`/`waivedScope`) collapse to this single shape. The Attestation `targetFinding` MUST equal this finding's IRI.

openedAt.description: Legacy alias for `detectedAt`. New producers SHOULD emit `detectedAt`.

findings.description: ValidationReport MUST carry a findings collection (may be empty if no issues).

rules.description: RuleRegistry MUST list at least one rule.
